# Coastal Funding Blog

> Mortgage tips, loan program guides and market insights: VA, FHA, conventional and DSCR loans, mortgage rates, and working with a mortgage broker.

This blog is published by Coastal Funding Corporation, a mortgage broker. Articles are informational and are not a commitment to lend; rates and programs are subject to change.

## Business

- Lender/broker: Coastal Funding Corporation, NMLS 103035
- Local service area: Florida, South Carolina & Tennessee
- Coverage: primary-residence purchase and refinance loans in Florida, South Carolina and Tennessee; DSCR investment-property loans nationwide
